lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No. 7,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Do you have a moment?
Yes, what is it?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You know how I endorse a healthy and cultured lifestyle

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: for the people that live in the Ark?
I have lots to say, but decide to drop it.
Very true, and we're all grateful to you for that.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Aww, really?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: What are you up to, showering me with such compliments?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Anyway, would you like to be my first test subject?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You can try the immortality potion that I whipped up last time.
Immortality itself is a fictional construct.
If anything, I think drinking that potion will kill me sooner.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Aw, don't be so mean! That's not true.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Fine then, for the well-being of the people,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I would appreciate your cooperation in another capacity.
What exactly?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Come in for a physical.
What precisely does that entail?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Not much.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: We'll start by measuring your height and weight.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Then move onto an EKG, brain wave detection, internal organ examination, blood tests, an MRI,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: allergic reaction panel, a psychological exam, an endoscopy, and a few more routine tests.
The fact that they're all so routine is exactly what's making me nervous...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Whatever do you mean?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Actually, could I ask you just one small favor?
Here we go.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I would like to take a small sample of your bone marrow during the blood test,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: some tissue samples from your organs during the endoscopy,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: and brain tissue during your MRI.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'd like to get a closer look at all those.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: That's okay, isn't it?
I don't feel like even answering.
I think I should just ignore Ether's messages from here on out.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No. 7?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Where did you go? Don't be like that.
